title: Relationship Pricing Note: Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance Reduction of Corrected Partial-Withdrawal Charges on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
An owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy and its recent premium payments bear on the corrected partial-withdrawal charge on that owner's Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract.

## Rule

The capped percentage of a corrected partial-withdrawal charge is reduced, never below zero:

- by **0.50 percentage point (0.005)** where the owner holds an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy with at least **12** whole life premium payments in the twelve months before the correction is booked;
- by **0.25 percentage point (0.0025)** where the owner holds an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy with at least one but fewer than 12 such payments;
- not at all otherwise.

The result is the reduced percentage.

## Records read

- The owner's Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy and its status: the reduction needs a policy whose status is in force.
- That policy's activity history: the premium payment entries dated in the twelve months before the booking date of the correction.

## Judgement table

| Whole Life Insurance policy of the owner | Premium payments in the twelve months before booking | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| In force | 12 or more | 0.50 point |
| In force | 1 to 11 | 0.25 point |
| In force | None | None |
| Held but not in force (for example lapsed or surrendered) | Any number | None |
| No Whole Life Insurance policy | — | None |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- Capped percentage 3%, owner's in-force whole life policy shows 12 monthly premium payments in the period: reduced percentage 2.50%.
- Same, with 7 payments: 2.75%.
- Capped percentage 0.25%, reduction 0.50 point: reduced percentage 0% — never below zero.
